Copy this into Cursor Agent after installing and configuring the plugin. No key is included.

> Use the veo MCP tool veo_text_to_video for one video request. I checked the current Ace Data Cloud price and balance. Use model veo31-fast if this account offers it. Set aspect_ratio 16:9. Set prompt to A teal cube on a cream table, gentle camera orbit, studio lighting, no text.. Submit at most once, keep the task ID, query it using veo_get_task until terminal, and open the completed result. If pending, report the ID so I can resume without a second generation.
